features: Sliding Door in Reception Which Creates 2nd Bed/Study
Underfloor Heating Included in the Service Charge
Great Transport Links Inc Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Spacious and bright one-bedroom 'L' shaped apartment (Type 20), offering flexible accommodation with space to be used as a two-bedroom home. South facing and located on the sixth floor, the apartment benefits from three full-height, floor-to-ceiling door/windows leading onto a balcony, flooding the living space with natural light. The living room benefits from electrically operated heat-reflective transparent blinds, while the bedroom is fitted with manual heat-reflective transparent blinds.
The property features a refurbished kitchen and bathroom, a separate WC, and a generous double bedroom with built-in cupboards overlooking the residents' gardens. Underfloor heating is included within the service charge.
Residents enjoy lift access, beautifully maintained private gardens, and the convenience of 24-hour car park attendants who can hold keys and accept deliveries. Thomas More has direct access to the residents’ gardens. Car parking and secure bicycle storage are available by separate negotiation with the City of London.
Please note that pets are not permitted under the terms of the head lease.
Designed by the renowned architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon, the Grade II-listed Barbican Estate is home to the renowned Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, theatre, restaurants, bars and cafés. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are all close by, while the Elizabeth Line at Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations are within easy walking distance. Barbican, St Paul's and Moorgate Underground stations are also nearby, providing excellent transport links across London.
Service Charge: Estimated £6,124 (01/04/2026 – 31/03/2027)
Lease: Extended to July 2196
Ground Rent: Peppercorn
